market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $70,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: BTC trading ~$78,500 on May 3 2026. Reaching $70,000 by May 31 requires roughly a 10.8% drawdown to a 1-min low. Historical monthly max drawdown >=10% occurs ~15-20% of months in BTC. Slightly elevated by recent consolidation/weakness from prior highs but no acute catalyst identified.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Magnitude of any macro/risk shock in the next 28 days; intraday 1-min wick could trigger early.
